name: mcb-hrm-ghana
description: MCB HRM Ghana — Advanced Workforce Management System

scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev -- --force"
scripts.build: cd server && npm run build && cd ../client && npm run build
scripts.test: cd server && npm test && cd ../client && npm test
scripts.lint: npm run lint:server && npm run lint:client && cd client && npm run lint
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:migrate:dev: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:status: cd server && npx prisma migrate status
